rapport_notes: Attentive and reassuring about a real logistical worry (afternoon move running late into a second job).

evidence_quotes.agenda: Are there any specific concerns or questions that you'd like answered on this call in regards to the move?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer's wardrobe-box question and afternoon-timing worry (worried about running late into a second move) were both followed up on with specific, reassuring answers.

top_strength: Proactively covered the full Communication takeaway (day-before call, on-the-way call) unprompted and used the customer's own move-history detail (5.5 hours last time) to build a genuinely personalized, credible estimate.
coaching_note: No Save Your Ass lines and no close ask were used -- the call ends on 'send the confirmation' with no explicit ask, despite good rapport that would have supported one.
